supportPolicy: Microsoft supports Azure Connected Machine agent releases from the preceding 12 months.
automaticUpgradePolicy: Do not enable or change automatic agent upgrades for this demo without an approved ring strategy. Existing settings are reported for review only.

classification.approvedLag: Matches the approved standard release, one release behind current.
classification.aging: Supported but older than the approved standard release.
classification.outOfSupport: Older than the documented minimum supported release.
classification.exception: An active, documented exception overrides the version classification until its expiration.
